name: io.github.michal1609/mgtranscriber
title: MGTranscriber
description: Transcribe videos and files on your GPU with speaker labels; search and read your transcripts.

environmentVariables.name: MGTRANSCRIBER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of a running MGTranscriber web server, if it uses one (jobs are sent there).

environmentVariables.name: HF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hugging Face token; needed for speaker labels (pyannote diarization models).
